ValidationRule.description: This rule requires that a product status is required prior to saving the lead record. This rule is specific to the EPP product status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( And( ISBLANK( FPC_Rep_EPP__c ),NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT( Status_EPP__c )))), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(FPC_Rep_EPP__c)),ISBLANK(TEXT(Status_EPP__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If FPC Rep EPP is populated the Status EPP is required.
